stories.story_fr: Les livraisons de vehicules 100% electriques reculent de 7,7% au T1 2026 a 200 000 unites dans un marche global en repli, signal d'un ralentissement de la transition electrique pour le groupe.
stories.story_en: All-electric vehicle deliveries decline 7.7% in Q1 2026 to 200,000 units in a declining overall market, signaling a slowdown in the group's electric transition.
stories.quote: Deliveries of all-electric vehicles to customers down by -7.7% on prior-year period at 200 (217) thousand units in a declining overall market

stories.story_fr: Les livraisons totales du groupe reculent de 4,0% a 2,0 millions de vehicules au T1 2026, reflet d'un marche automobile mondial sous pression et de ventes en baisse notable en Europe de l'Ouest.
stories.story_en: Total group deliveries decline 4.0% to 2.0 million vehicles in Q1 2026, reflecting a global auto market under pressure and notably lower sales in Western Europe.
stories.quote: down by 4.0% year-on-year to 2.0 million vehicles in the first quarter of 2026
